title: Evaluating an evidence-guided reinforcement learning framework in aligning light-parameter large language models with decision-making cognition in psychiatric clinical reasoning
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measured the performance of LLMs on psychiatric clinical reasoning tasks. It did not measure any aspects related to faith or religion.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as this was not a focus of the research.
